pages.text: $(item)Awakened Draconium$() is the upgraded form of Draconium, needed for Draconic-tier gear, injectors and cores, and for the outer shell of a tier 8 $(l:energy_core/overview)Energy Core$(/l).

It cannot be mined. It is made with $(l:fusion_crafting/overview)Fusion Crafting$(/l): four $(item)Draconium Blocks$() in the core, with six $(item)Draconium Cores$() and one $(item)Dragon Heart$() in the injectors. The craft needs $(l)Wyvern injectors or better$() and 50 million OP, and gives four $(item)Awakened Draconium Blocks$().

pages.title: The Dragon Heart
pages.text: Every time the $(item)Ender Dragon$() dies, a Dragon Heart appears floating above the exit portal. It does not despawn, so come back for it after the fight.$(br2)The $(l:endgame/chaos_guardian)Chaos Guardian$(/l) drops one too.

pages.title: Using it
pages.text: One Dragon Heart makes four blocks, which is 36 ingots. Each block splits into nine $(item)Awakened Draconium Ingots$(), and each ingot into nine nuggets, the same way as normal Draconium.$(br2)Since the dragon can be fought again, every respawn is another heart. Look up $(item)Awakened Draconium$() in JEI to see where it is used.
